# LocalPlasticityPipeline

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hybrid ANN-SNN processing pipeline where local plasticity rules govern synaptic updates within the SNN component, enabling online learning without global error signals. This enables energy-efficient, biologically plausible learning in neuromorphic hardware, critical for in-network adaptive processing.
